reviews.title: Assistenza clienti completamente inesistente
reviews.text:
Esperienza assolutamente vergognosa. Non è tanto l’errore in sé, che può capitare a chiunque, quanto la totale incompetenza dimostrata nella gestione del problema.

Dopo aver ricevuto un ordine completamente sbagliato, ho contattato l’assistenza, fornendo persino entrambi gli scontrini che dimostravano inequivocabilmente lo scambio. Nonostante le prove concrete, Deliveroo ha deciso di negarmi il rimborso.

Alla richiesta di spiegazioni, mi è stata fornita una risposta generica, piena di scuse di circostanza e completamente priva di una motivazione reale. In sostanza, un cliente paga, non riceve ciò che ha acquistato e viene pure lasciato senza una soluzione.

Un servizio clienti che, davanti a una situazione documentata, non è in grado di offrire né una spiegazione seria né una risoluzione del problema è semplicemente inaccettabile.

La fiducia si perde proprio così: non per un singolo errore, ma per il modo in cui si sceglie di trattare chi paga.

Esperienza pessima, assistenza deludente e gestione del reclamo vergognosa. Non utilizzerò mai più questo servizio.

reviews.title: Worst customer service in Dubai. Pure gaslighting
reviews.text:
Deliveroo pretends to have great service for your first few orders to hook you in, but the moment you buy a subscription, customer support drops to zero. Their chat agents don’t solve problems—they just gaslight you into thinking everything is fine or that it’s somehow your fault.
Here is what they consider «normal»:
1. Ordered a hot coffee, received a bag of raw coffee beans instead. Support’s response: «Nothing we can do.»
2. Ordered oatmeal and clearly stated an allergy in the notes (no jam). It arrived with jam. Support blamed me, saying I «should have called the restaurant directly» and refused to help.
3. Received a completely wrong grocery item from a supermarket. Support said: «Sorry, no refund, but you can keep the wrong item.»
Paying for a subscription just to argue with abusive support and throw away money on wrong orders is ridiculous. I’ve canceled my subscription and switched to Keeta and Talabat. Do yourself a favor and stay away from Deliveroo.

reviews.text:
This is absolutely unacceptable and extremely disappointing service!

The delivery service has been very poor, and the only response I received from your customer service team was, “We will compensate you for your order.”

Let me make one thing very clear: What is the point of compensation if the food is not delivered on time? Compensation cannot replace the time lost, the inconvenience caused, or the disappointment of waiting for an order that was supposed to arrive on time.

Customers place orders expecting reliable and timely service, not excuses or compensation after the damage has already been done.

Your delivery team has completely failed to meet basic service standards, and your customer service response shows a lack of seriousness in addressing the actual problem.

I am not looking for compensation. I expect accountability, professionalism, and an explanation for this unacceptable delay.

Shame on your delivery service. This is certainly not the level of service any customer should have to experience. If you cannot deliver on time, you should not promise a delivery time in the first place.

I sincerely hope your management takes this complaint seriously and takes immediate action to prevent such incidents from happening again.

reviews.title: Scammed out of my order
reviews.text:
I wouldn’t be writing as harsh a review if Deliveroos customer service wasn’t so shocking on top of appalling cancellation process. I ordered a delivery and put on there that I had dietary requirements. I requested immediately after I was informed that half of my items were being replaced with items I COULDNT EAT, that I wanted to cancel. I was told on chat that I couldn’t as it was in transit. I was informed to take it in my house. They said it was because the item was already in transit despite me replying within less than a minute of their amendments to my order.

All I asked for was a refund which they could only partially complete despite their huge add ons and service charges. I then spent the next THREE hours talking back and forth with 4 separate Customer services reps that all kept moving me on to the next guy which all said no. I can understand that a big part of the fault is with the food vendor but the app made it impossible to fix in time and the customer services reps were all appalling. Wasted 3 hours of my life and stole £35 (they did refund £12).

If you enjoy having a mystery box and a 3 hour chat with a brick wall by all means go with Deliveroo. If not I’d recommend JustEat.

However, I contacted the driver and asked him to wait just two minutes because I was on my way, yet my food was left somewhere I couldn’t find it, and customer support offered no meaningful help. Today, I spent €52 on an order that arrived with missing sauces and dips, and received a measly €3.60 app credit despite the order not being delivered as described. I understand that mistakes happen, but what matters is how a company handles them. Deliveroo has repeatedly shown a complete lack of accountability, communication, and customer care. It’s incredibly frustrating to pay for a service and be left feeling completely ripped off when something goes wrong. You kinda just have to pray that your order is delivered properly or else die hungry.

reviews.title: Very disappointing experience with Deliveroo.
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience with Deliveroo. I ordered green chillies for cooking curries, but the item delivered was completely different from the product shown in the app. I received a large type of chilli commonly used for making bajji/fritters, and the item was not fresh either.

I contacted customer support and shared clear photos showing the difference between the product listed and the item delivered. However, despite the clear mismatch and the poor freshness of the item, I was repeatedly told that no refund or compensation could be provided.

I understand that feedback may be documented for future improvements, but customers also expect a fair resolution when the wrong or mismatched product is delivered. This experience was disappointing, and I hope Deliveroo improves product accuracy, freshness, and customer support resolution in the future.

reviews.title: Unrecognized Subscription, No Cancellation Option, and Terrible Customer Experience
reviews.text:
Unrecognized Subscription, No Cancellation Option, and Terrible Customer Experience

I am extremely disappointed with Deliveroo Plus. I found an active monthly subscription that I did not recognize, and when I tried to cancel it, there was no cancellation option available in the app. The subscription also did not appear under my Apple subscriptions, leaving me with no way to stop the recurring charges on my own.

A company should never make it difficult for customers to cancel a subscription. If you can sign up in minutes, you should be able to cancel just as easily. Instead, customers are forced to contact support simply to stop being charged.

This experience has been frustrating, misleading, and unacceptable. I expect Deliveroo to cancel my subscription immediately, refund the unauthorized charge, and improve the transparency of its subscription management. Until this issue is resolved, I cannot recommend Deliveroo Plus to anyone.

reviews.title: I had a very disappointing experience…
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Deliveroo. I paid over £10 for toilet paper that was missing from my order. When I contacted customer support, I felt that my concerns were not properly investigated and that the driver's account was accepted without adequately addressing the evidence I provided.

The most frustrating part was not just the missing item, but how the complaint was handled. Rather than feeling supported as a customer, I felt dismissed throughout the process.

In contrast, Sainsbury's customer service was helpful and agreed to let me collect the missing toilet paper the following day, which resolved the issue.

Based on this experience, I've decided to delete my Deliveroo account. I hope Deliveroo improves both its complaint handling process and how it investigates disputes between customers and drivers, because customers deserve to feel that their concerns are considered fairly.

reviews.title: poor and frustrating , unreliable and irresponsible app and its services
reviews.text:
I ordered dinner through the app and waited patiently for more than an hour, only to find that my order had been cancelled automatically. After making enquiries, I was informed that the driver had already collected the order but then cancelled the delivery and switched off their phone.

I was later told that a refund would be issued, but that does not change the fact that I was left without my dinner after waiting for such a long time. From a customer’s perspective, it appeared as though the order was picked up and never delivered, which is completely unacceptable.

What made the situation even worse was the lack of accessible customer support. There was no straightforward way to speak to someone or get immediate assistance, and leaving a public review felt like the only option remaining.

This level of service is irresponsible and highly disappointing. A food delivery service should be reliable, transparent and able to support customers when problems occur. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend Deliveroo and will think very carefully before using the service again.

reviews.title: The rider can keep your meal
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience. I placed an order worth nearly AED 300, and the rider called me when he arrived. I missed the call, but my front door was wide open and the order could have been left at the door. Instead, the rider left with my food, and I never received my order.

To make matters worse, Deliveroo refused to compensate me or issue a refund, even though I paid in full and received absolutely nothing. I lost nearly AED 300 without getting my meal, and the customer service response was unacceptable.

This experience has completely destroyed my trust in Deliveroo. Customers should not have to pay for food they never receive because a rider chooses not to leave the order. I will not be using this service again, and I cannot recommend it to anyone.

reviews.title: Pessima qualità e nessun supporto da Deliveroo
reviews.text:
Ordine pessimo sotto ogni punto di vista. Ho ordinato due menù e le patatine di entrambe le porzioni sono arrivate ammassate tutte insieme nello stesso sacchetto, schiacciate, unte e con un aspetto davvero disgustoso. Sembravano vecchie, come se fossero state preparate molto tempo prima e non certo appena fatte. La qualità del cibo era talmente scadente che non ho nemmeno avuto il coraggio di assaggiarlo e sono stata costretta a buttare tutto.
Anche i panini erano in condizioni pessime: il pollo all’interno aveva un aspetto poco invitante e non trasmetteva alcuna fiducia sulla freschezza e sulla preparazione del prodotto. Nel complesso, il cibo ricevuto sembrava tutt’altro rispetto a ciò che dovrebbe essere consegnato a un cliente pagante.
La cosa ancora più deludente è stata l’assistenza. In pratica, per quanto riguarda un cibo arrivato unto, schiacciato e in condizioni inaccettabili, si sono limitati a scaricare la responsabilità sul ristorante senza offrire una soluzione concreta.
Ho pagato per due menù e mi è stato consegnato un ordine che non rispettava minimamente gli standard di qualità e presentazione che qualsiasi cliente dovrebbe aspettarsi. reviews.title: Hefty prices, slow delivery times, cold food and poor customer service
reviews.text:
Deliveroo is supposed to make life easier.

This morning I ordered groceries from Shuppa. The driver collected the order at 12:30pm and the journey should have taken no more than 15–20 minutes.

Instead, nearly an hour later, I'm still waiting.

When I contacted Deliveroo support, their response was simply: "We recommend you keep waiting."

I'm now running late for a business meeting, there are no traffic issues in the area, and I haven't been given any meaningful ETA.

What appears to have happened is that my order was bundled with another delivery miles away from my location. That's great for the other customer, but it means my order has been significantly delayed despite being close to the pickup point.

At this stage I wanted to cancel the order and delete my account, but that wasn't even an option presented to me.

Poor communication, poor customer service, and a complete disregard for the customer's time.

reviews.title: Difficult to order
